assumptions: EPA annual fuel cost is based on 15,000 miles/year, 55% city / 45% highway driving, and the fuel prices FuelEconomy.gov currently uses (fuelPricesUsed, $/gal or $/kWh for electric). youSaveSpend5yr compares 5 years of fuel cost to the EPA average new vehicle; positive = save, negative = spend more.
costToOwnNote: Only EPA fuel-cost figures are reported. Full cost-to-own (depreciation, insurance, maintenance, repairs) is NOT available from this source.
